newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares continue to climb in high turnover.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares continue to climb in high turnover.

text.p: Egyptian share prices continued to rise on Sunday with cement shares dominating busy trading.
The Capital Markets Authority (CMA) overall index closed 0.04 points up at 235.02, the highest since April 1995, with turnover an above-average 28.28 million pounds ($8.32 million).
Cement favourites performed well overall, with Suez Cement leading the day's trading, rising 4.63 pounds to close at 47.01. Shares worth 7.85 million pounds were traded.

Amriyah Cement rose 0.51 pounds to finish at 56.01 after more than 28,000 shares exchanged hands while more than 18,000 shares in Helwan Portland Cement were traded pushing its price up 1.00 pound to 42.75.
North Cairo Flour Mills continued to do well, rising 0.20 pounds to close at 96.80. Shares worth 6.88 million were traded.
The CMA index for openly traded firms rose to 353.81 points form 345.26 on Thursday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms went up to 160.73 points from 160.72.
